name: Pitling
description: A cracked seat in the mud of the pit, and the first thing the darkness calls you.

name: Ash-Seer
description: Grey dust settles on your shoulders and shows you what the next fights will bring.

name: Twin-Diggers
description: Two shafts, two shovels, and twice the work carved out of the same grave.

name: Ironfist
description: Your grip tightens on every relic you find and the vault sorts itself without you.

name: Godservant
description: A voice inside the walls passes your orders to the manager that walks the tree.

name: Soulcounter
description: The pit counts the souls it takes and keeps a running total in your name.

name: Runebinder
description: You carve binding runes into every relic and the forge rerolls them for you.

name: Shadowlord
description: Your shadow leaves the throne and scouts the deeper halls on its own.

name: Divine Voice
description: Three expeditions answer your call at once and the dead pay their souls in real time.

name: The New God
description: The hollow throne accepts you and the pit becomes a temple that never closes.
